definition: Gato is a deep neural network for a range of complex tasks that exhibits multimodality.
details: It can perform tasks such as engaging in a dialogue, playing video games, controlling a robot arm to stack blocks, and more.
story: Picture an architect laying out a building where every room has to know which other rooms matter to it. The layout decides what the machine can even attempt, before it learns a single thing. It is the blueprint that makes everything else possible. It is the difference between a row of isolated cubicles and one big room where everyone can hear each other. And that shape of the machine — Gato (DeepMind) — is what makes everything else possible.
